Dryad (CV 17)

A woodland spirit carries the grain and scent of a particular tree in living skin and hair.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 20 · Speed: 6 · Footprint: 1x1

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: 1 Boon. · Stability: 0.

DR / resistance: None · Condition immunities: None

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: Common

Eligibility: Fey 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use the controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or if the controller is unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot. No summon chains.

Carrying: At most 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No crafting training.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
Thorn-wrapped staffBrawnNone2 physical damage.4 physical damage. Grappled 1.6 physical damage. Grappled 2.

Thorn-wrapped staff: One visible creature within 2 squares. The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

Maneuvers

Weave the Roots — Maneuver: Choose up to 3 connected difficult-terrain ground squares within 3 squares; they count as normal terrain until the start of the controller’s next turn. Requires soil or living vegetation; cannot bridge empty space or bypass occupied squares.

Defend: Gain 1 Boon to defenses until the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: Brawn None; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.
